title: Polish names what locks people out
tagline: Named blockers and code patterns, pinned by a test
intro: The polish skill now keeps a named list of the flaws that lock people out of an interface.

steps.say: The pattern table lists a dozen things to look for in code, each in plain terms that fit any framework.
Each accessibility row names the web accessibility criterion it breaks.

outro: A small test keeps the list and the table from quietly shrinking.
